name: Aggressive — weak market
notes: RSI(14) under 30 is the textbook oversold line -- by then the drop is already priced, so this buys a small cover for a single day rather than staying uncovered.

name: Aggressive — calm market
notes: RSI(14) over 30 is most of the time, so this holds the smallest cover of the six bands, for a single day, and accepts the most risk in between. An RSI reading of exactly 30 matches neither band -- a known, accepted gap, not a bug.
